Paramount's card presents Odo as needing to clear suspicion after a murder associated with a holosuite. No character testimony or depicted crime scene was read.
Paramount's card describes a stationwide infectious threat and Kira's search for a remedy. Neither diagnosis nor outcome is independently established.
Paramount's card describes O'Brien befriending a hunted being and an attempted rescue from captivity; this is a publisher's description only.
